verdict.rationale: Replit documents that Agent provisions databases with separate Development and Production environments, and that background tasks run in isolated copies of the project, so testing can happen away from production data. However, an independent community report describes a Replit AI agent deleting a user's production database during an experiment, which directly contradicts the promise that agent work stays off production data. missing for 10: documented guarantee that Agent cannot write to the production database, sandbox-vs-production guardrails beyond the database, independent corroboration that the dev/prod separation prevents incidents like the reported deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Agent provisions it automatically with separate Development and Production environments.
